legal.termsOfServicePrivateMvp: Terms of Service · Private MVP draft
legal.tingMapIsAPublic: Ting map is a public community where people recommend and verify how well places fit a theme. It does not guarantee general ratings or opening status. Please check a place's official information before visiting.
legal.onlySubmitInformationYouWrote: Only submit information you wrote yourself or have the right to share. Don't copy search results, photos or reviews from other providers without permission. Spam, false contributions, sharing personal information and vote manipulation are restricted. Moderators may review, hide content or limit accounts under the community guidelines.
legal.googleMapsAndPlaceSearch: Google Maps and place search are subject to the
legal.beforePublicLaunchTheOperator: Before public launch, the operator, contact channel, account deletion and appeal procedures must be finalized. This document is for private development review.
legal.signInEmailAndAuthentication: Sign-in email and authentication data are handled by Supabase Auth. We store your public profile name, bio and image, public contributions such as suggestions and comments, and your private saves and follows. Only you can see your saved list.
legal.whenYouSearchForA: When you search for a new place, your search term and city are sent to Google. Raw API responses and keys are not kept in usage logs. API usage records include the action, time, result, estimated cost and the user identifier needed to apply limits.
legal.whenUsingGoogleServicesPlease: When using Google services, please review the
legal.mapProvidersMayReceiveConnection: . Map providers may receive connection details such as your browser's IP address.
legal.beforePublicLaunchTheData: Before public launch, the data controller, contact details, retention period, overseas transfers and access/deletion request procedures must be finalized for the production environment.
